evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and modifies test_framework/util.py by adding assert_true() and assert_false() helper functions.
rationale: This PR is an internal test framework cleanup to reduce cognitive load and enforce boolean assertions. The author notes that 'the main point of this change is that assert_true()/assert_false() reduce cognitive tokens when scanning the code'; such cosmetic and syntactic cleanups rank at the bottom of the testing hierarchy.
